mapper.select: SELECT `failed_count` as failedCount, `user_id` as userId, `last_failed_time` as lastFailedTime, `locked_until` as lockedUntil FROM `login_failed_count` WHERE `user_id` = #{value} for update
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `login_captcha` (`session_id`, `code`, `expired_time`) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{code}, #{expiredTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `code` = #{code}, `expired_time` = #{expiredTime}

INSERT INTO `login_failed_count` (`user_id`, `failed_count`, `last_failed_time`, `locked_until`) VALUES (#{userId}, #{failedCount}, #{lastFailedTime}, #{lockedUntil}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE failed_count = (failed_count + 1), `last_failed_time` = #{lastFailedTime}, `locked_until` = #{lockedUntil}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_captcha WHERE NOW(3) > expired_time
DELETE FROM `login_audit` WHERE `login_time` < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{value} DAY)
